source.label: Placed in M31 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 769,731 pc (src/objects/m31-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 776,247 pc from the Local Volume Database v1.1.1 (Pace 2025), inclination 74 deg, line of nodes 37.7 deg). The pair's own measured distance: Distance 724 +/- 37 kpc, (m-M)0 = 24.30 +/- 0.11 mag, from the pair's own radii, temperatures and brightness, Vilardell et al. (2010), A&A 509, A70, Table 3; it is told in the text, and the star is drawn in the galaxy

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Reeve & Howarth (2016), MNRAS 456, 1294 compute from non-LTE TLUSTY model atmospheres for the Bessell V band at 33,600 K and log g 3.85 (u1 0.082, u2 0.292): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

physical.credit: Primary radius 9.2 +/- 0.2 solar radii, Vilardell et al. radius; Gaia DR3 position; cited distance; no measured rotation axis (display convention)
